mapper.select: SELECT k.id, k.name, k.description, k.created_at, k.updated_at, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS doc_count, COALESCE(d.chunk_count, 0) AS chunk_count FROM flow_knowledge k LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kb_id, COUNT(*) AS doc_count, SUM(chunk_count) AS chunk_count FROM flow_knowledge_doc WHERE status = 'READY' GROUP BY kb_id ) d ON d.kb_id = k.id WHERE k.id = #{id}

SELECT k.id, k.name, k.description, k.created_at, k.updated_at, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS doc_count, COALESCE(d.chunk_count, 0) AS chunk_count FROM flow_knowledge k LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kb_id, COUNT(*) AS doc_count, SUM(chunk_count) AS chunk_count FROM flow_knowledge_doc WHERE status = 'READY' GROUP BY kb_id ) d ON d.kb_id = k.id ORDER BY k.updated_at DESC
